pages.text: Using Aging Cream and some magic, you can artificially cultivate an Immortal Embryo, allowing it to grow into the apex predator of the Abyssal Chasm.

Just like another interdimensional predator, you can right-click the Hullbreaker while holding fish to heal it. When the owner wears Abyss Robe, the Hullbreaker also passively regenerates health over time.
When a Hullbreaker is slain, it returns an Immortal Embryo. If Goety Cataclysm installed, you can also summon a Hullbreaker through a different ritual.
